note: Fan/community posts are discovery leads, never publishable facts by themselves. A lead must be corroborated by an official source or multiple reliable independent sources before it can enter the article pipeline.

rules: Never treat a fan post as confirmation of schedules, health, relationships, legal issues, private information, or allegations.
Preserve the original post URL for editorial review.
Do not copy fan photos, videos, translations, or text into published HallyuScope content without permission or a clear lawful basis.
Verified fan-origin leads may become articles only after the claim is independently corroborated.
